notes: A more premium look and feel throughout the app, plus fixes: Google sign-in for sync now works correctly, sync rides on that same Google sign-in instead of being a separate confusing one, and sites that don't support a secure connection can be reached again with a one-tap warning.

desktop.notes: Fixes bookmark sync, which wasn't working, and folds "Sign in to sync" into the same Google sign-in instead of a separate one.
